summary: Master web development using the Python Django Framework. Join our course to create powerful web applications and boost your programming expertise!
lede: Web development using the Python Django framework teaches you to build and maintain a structured Python web application. You will practise project configuration, URL routing, models and migrations, templates, forms, authentication, testing with Django TestCase, and deployment preparation. The course connects Django’s Model-Template-View structure, ORM, middleware, settings, static files, and reusable application components to practical outputs. By the end, you will have a functioning application, documented data relationships, tested user journeys, and a prioritized plan for further development.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who need to build or support Python web applications with Django. It suits learners with basic programming experience who want structured practice with database-backed application delivery.
prerequisites: You should have basic Python programming experience, including variables, functions, conditional logic, collections, and simple object-oriented concepts. Familiarity with HTML and CSS, relational database ideas, and command-line navigation will help, but prior Django experience is not required. Coding is required for completion, though the exercises focus on guided Python and Django implementation rather than advanced software engineering. Advanced API architecture, asynchronous processing, cloud infrastructure, and AI-assisted development are introduced at conceptual or operational application level, not production engineering level. Bring a laptop with permission to install Python, Django, Git, and a code editor such as Visual Studio Code. Training files and a practice dataset can be provided for the exercises.
